name: long_repetitive_bench
description: Benchmarks model robustness to long, highly repetitive text inputs, measuring tendencies to degenerate (e.g., produce looping/repetitive output) and ability to maintain coherent generation over extended contexts. Designed to stress long-context handling and repetition-avoidance mechanisms.
evaluation_method: accuracy (automatic metrics for repetition/consistency) and automated repetition/diversity metrics
reputation: Small, community-contributed Hugging Face benchmark with limited adoption; primarily used for robustness testing.
